facts.value: You will get your ASURITE User ID and activation instructions shortly after you submit your application.
A message from asu.edu will be sent to the email address you provided in your application with the subject line 'ASU Account Activation'.
If you can't remember your ASURITE User ID, you can look it up at: asu.edu/lostpassword
You will log in to My ASU with your ASURITE User ID and password.
You can view your priority tasks and next steps for enrollment, advisor contact information, financial aid and billing information, and connect to campus technology and services on My ASU.
Navigate to my.asu.edu, enter your ASURITE User ID and password, and click the 'Sign In' button.
After you enroll in classes, visit asu.edu/emailsignup to activate your official @asu.edu email address.
Be sure to check both your non-ASU personal email address and your ASU Gmail inbox regularly.
